findings.location: Body, opening sentence (line 12): the inline-math labels for C_2 × C_2 and C_2 × C_3.
findings.evidence: The source writes C_2\\times C_2 and C_2\\times C_3, with two literal backslashes before times in each inline-math expression. The \\ line-break command is not valid in ordinary inline math; the intended symbol requires the single command \times. Both product-group labels are therefore ill-formed for rendering.
